name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted newsletter app with subscriber lists, segmentation, templates and campaigns, served on admin, sandbox and public hostnames with MariaDB and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment settings. The container applies it again on every start, so change the password there: a change made in the Mailtrain UI is reverted at the next restart.

Mailtrain also uses sandbox.<your domain> for the template editors and lists.<your domain> for subscription forms and unsubscribe links. Both must resolve to this server with HTTPS, otherwise the editors stay blank and links in sent emails break.
The builtin mail transfer agent is disabled. Before sending, edit the System send configuration in Administration > Send Configurations and enter your SMTP server details.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
